grammar.summary: 本课以「卡蒂萨克」号帆船的比赛为主线，重点运用了被动语态、定语从句以及与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句。体会作者如何用被动语态客观叙述船只的遭遇、用定语从句补充比赛细节、用 if...had not...would have 对历史作出反事实推断。

points.title: 被动语态 (Passive Voice)
points.explanation: be + 过去分词构成被动语态，突出动作的承受者。本课大量以船只为主语用被动叙述：被替换、被看见、被袭击、被装上新舵，使帆船命运的叙述更客观紧凑。

examples.en: Before they were replaced by steamships, sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia.
examples.cn: 在蒸汽船取代帆船之前，「卡蒂萨克」号之类的帆船被用来从中国运回茶叶，从澳大利亚运回羊毛。

examples.en: In August, she was struck by a very heavy storm during which her rudder was torn away.
examples.cn: 8月份「卡蒂萨克」号遭到一场特大风暴的袭击，失去了一只舵。

points.title: which/that 引导的定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: which/that 指物引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 which 修饰 race（持续四个月的比赛），用 that 修饰 ships（曾建造的最快帆船），使长句信息密集。

examples.en: This race, which went on for exactly four exactly four months, was the last of its kind.
examples.cn: 这场比赛持续了整整4个月，是这类比赛中的最后一次。

examples.en: The Cutty Sark was one the fastest sailing ships that has ever been built.
examples.cn: 「卡蒂萨克」号是帆船制造史上建造的最快的一艘帆船。

points.title: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句 (Third Conditional)
points.explanation: 表示对过去事实的反事实假设：if 从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would/could/might + have + 过去分词。本课结尾用此结构推断「若未失舵，本可轻易夺冠」，为全文画龙点睛。

examples.en: These is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问，如果中途没有失去舵，「卡帝萨克」号肯定能在比赛中轻易夺冠。

exercises.q: Before they ______ by steamships, sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China.
This race, ______ went on for exactly four months, was the last of its kind.
There is no doubt that if she had not lost her rudder she ______ the race easily.（与过去事实相反的虚拟语气）
用动词原形填空：The Cutty Sark rolled from side to side and it became impossible to ______ (steer) her.
课文中 She serves as an impressive reminder of the great ships of past 的 serves as 意思是？
